# Bright Fine-Line Gongbi Prompt Fixture

This is a semantic snapshot for static acceptance review. It is not a
generated image, a character card, or a canonical asset. Equivalent natural
wording is valid when it preserves the same constraints.

## Required visual-language markers

- cool-white or near-white paper;
- generous narrative negative space or breathing room;
- very fine warm gray-brown or lightly colored linework;
- precise local gongbi-like detail;
- transparent, pale, low-muddiness watercolor;
- extremely light neutral-gray or pale blue-gray shadow;
- important areas detailed, secondary areas lightly described, atmospheric
  areas allowed to remain unpainted;
- handwritten mood-diary page, not commercial illustration.

## Required avoid markers

- thick black outlines;
- muddy opaque watercolor;
- full-frame sepia, yellow, or gray grading;
- heavy uniform shadows;
- dense decorative background;
- sticker or commercial-poster aesthetics;
- glossy 3D or plastic rendering;
- genericized character markings;
- unapproved anthropomorphism.

## Prompt assembly order

1. Character authority
2. Diary intent
3. Visual language
4. Scene construction
5. Emotion direction
6. Text policy
7. Relevant avoid rules
